hints.title: Only Process Rows with Reserved Seats
hints.text: Rows with zero reserved seats can always seat 2 four-person families (seats 2-5 and 6-9).

hints.title: Three Possible 4-Person Blocks
hints.text: In any row, a four-person group can fit only in: left (2-5), right (6-9), or middle (4-7).

hints.title: Bitmask per Row
hints.text: Encode occupied columns using bit positions. For each reserved row, check if left and right fit, or middle fits.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Creating an explicit array of size n x 10 causes memory limit exceeded for n up to 10^9.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Only storing rows with reservations in a dictionary keeps memory proportional to M.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate notices empty rows contribute 2 families automatically and checks bitmasks for affected rows.
complexity.notes: Columns 1 and 10 do not affect 4-person family placement.
